failures.question: 发生过价格变动的商品，按类目统计平均涨跌幅和关联订单数，取订单数前 20。
failures.generatedSql:
-- 先按商品汇总价格变动率，再按类目平均；订单数单独按类目去重统计，避免与价格历史明细相乘放大
WITH product_changes AS (
  SELECT h.product_id,
         AVG((h.new_price - h.old_price) / NULLIF(h.old_price, 0)) AS avg_change
  FROM product_price_history h
  GROUP BY h.product_id
),
cat_change AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS category,
         AVG(pc.avg_change) AS avg_change
  FROM product_changes pc
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pc.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name
),
cat_orders AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS category,
         COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_cnt
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN product_changes pc ON pc.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name
)
SELECT cc.category,
       ROUND(cc.avg_change, 4) AS avg_change_rate,
       COALESCE(co.order_cnt, 0) AS order_cnt
FROM cat_change cc
LEFT JOIN cat_orders co ON co.category = cc.category
ORDER BY order_cnt DESC
LIMIT 20;

WITH anchor AS (

),
stock AS (
    SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS current_stock
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
),

)

FROM warehouses w

LEFT JOIN outbound o ON o.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
ORDER BY w.warehouse_id
LIMIT 1000;

WITH product_changes AS (

  FROM product_price_history h
  GROUP BY h.product_id
),
cat_change AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS category,
         AVG(pc.avg_change) AS avg_change
  FROM product_changes pc
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pc.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name
),
cat_orders AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS category,
         COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_cnt
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN product_changes pc ON pc.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name
)
SELECT cc.category,

       COALESCE(co.order_cnt, 0) AS order_cnt
FROM cat_change cc
LEFT JOIN cat_orders co ON co.category = cc.category
ORDER BY order_cnt DESC

-- 各仓库：当前库存、近90天出库量、库存周转天数（时间锚定 movement 最大时间）
WITH anchor AS (
    SELECT MAX(moved_at) AS max_at FROM inventory_movements
),
stock AS (
    SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS current_stock
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
),
outbound AS (
    SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS out_qty
    FROM inventory_movements
    WHERE movement_type = '2'
      AND moved_at >= (SELECT max_at FROM anchor) - INTERVAL '90 days'
      AND moved_at < (SELECT max_at FROM anchor) + INTERVAL '1 second'
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
)
SELECT w.warehouse_id,
       s.current_stock,
       o.out_qty,
       ROUND(90.0 * s.current_stock / NULLIF(o.out_qty, 0), 1) AS turnover_days
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN outbound o ON o.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
ORDER BY w.warehouse_id
LIMIT 1000;
